fields.label: Company Name
fields.description: Shown at the top of the TOS menu and on the carrier page.

fields.label: Default Terminal
fields.description: Used when a screen does not say which terminal.

fields.label: Carrier Portal On
fields.description: Switch off to stop carriers booking. Staff are not affected.

fields.label: Reject Wrong Container Check Digits
fields.description: Off: a wrong check digit only warns. On: it is refused.

fields.label: Earliest Arrival (minutes before slot)
fields.description: A truck earlier than this needs an override.

fields.label: Latest Arrival (minutes after slot ends)
fields.description: A truck later than this needs an override.

fields.label: Late After (minutes)
fields.description: An appointment is marked Late this long after its slot starts.

fields.label: Approved Override Valid For (hours)
fields.description: After this time an unused override expires.

fields.label: Override Needs a Different Approver
fields.description: The person who asks cannot approve it. A terminal can also require this for itself.

fields.label: Create the Yard Move Order After Gate In
fields.description: When a truck is admitted, a From Gate In move order is created for its new container. A terminal can choose Yes or No for itself.

fields.label: Operators Can Take Open Jobs
fields.description: Off: only a planner assigns move orders.

fields.label: Yard Geometry (metres)
fields.description: How the 3D yard sizes things. Change these only if your yard is built differently.

fields.label: Slot Length (one 20 ft bay)
fields.description: A 20 ft container is 6.06 m long; the rest is the gap between bays.

fields.label: Row Pitch
fields.description: Distance from the centre of one row to the next.

fields.label: Tier Height
fields.description: Height of one container level, including the gap.

fields.label: Gap Between Blocks
fields.description: Used when blocks are set out automatically.
